title: Restart drops pending supervisor notices to dispatchers
detail: At 94cddbae, restarting the daemon after a supervisor notice to a live dispatcher but before its five-minute deadline drops the pending notice from the in-memory dispatcherAsks timer (internal/daemon/attention_actions.go:258). Log recovery restores only self notices (internal/daemon/attention_log.go:84), and startup skips the already judged stop. With no new dispatcher model request, the delegate can stay quietly stopped indefinitely. Plot s-4kr3bn D12 requires the delegate's turn to open. Recover the pending notice and request baseline across restart, respecting resolution and closure. Two reviewers confirmed by source inspection; the existing deadline test does not restart and no fresh runtime reproduction was completed.
